last_etwap_base_supply_at_init.meaning: lastETWAPBaseSupply value seeded during market initialization

first_mint_crosses_no_cap_limit.meaning: a first minter performs a mint that crosses the noCapLimit threshold, adding just over one token

follow_up_deposit_blocked.meaning: new deposits are blocked for roughly an hour after a just-over-one-token mint crossing the threshold
follow_up_deposit_blocked.checkpoint: after the threshold-crossing mint, during the freeze window

assumptions: The first over-threshold minter is treated as an ordinary user; the report does not establish attacker authorization.
The mint that crosses the noCapLimit threshold is permissionless and not restricted to a privileged caller.
The 'roughly an hour' freeze is the reported duration of the blocked-deposit window.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of the noCapLimit threshold or the exact 'just over one token' amount; the crossing is represented as a grounded Boolean.
The 'roughly an hour' freeze duration is approximate and depends on ETWAP decay timing not fully specified; no exact numeric bound is available.

limitations: The freeze duration is approximate; the plan encodes the blocked-deposit outcome as a Boolean rather than a timed bound.
The noCapLimit threshold value is not numerically specified in the report.
Only the deposits_blocked_hour impact is formalized here; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
